name: BM GreenTech Berhad
summary: BM GreenTech Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the design and manufacturing of biomass boilers in Malaysia and Indonesia. It operates through the Bio-Energy, Water Treatment, and Solar Energy. It is involved in design, manufacturing, installation, and commissioning of bio-energy systems in palm oil mills, power plants, and other industries; engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning of industrial wastewater treatment solutions for palm oil, food, wood, paper, pulp, and data center industries; and supply of chemicals and parts for water treatment. The company also provides product upgrades, technical support, and repairs and maintenance of the bio-energy systems…
